description: This PHP source file defines a class 'DetailedProjectActivityReportMenuConfigurator' implementing the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It resides within the OrangeHRM Time plugin and is responsible for configuring the menu related to detailed project activity reports by overriding the screen with 'displayProjectReportCriteria'.

classes.name: DetailedProjectActivityReportMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Handles menu configuration for detailed project activity reports within the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'displayProjectReportCriteria' for the provided Screen object.
